LAW AND MOTION 301, PLAINTIFF SERIES GROUP LLC, A LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY ADJUDICATION OF PLAINTIFF'S FIRST CAUSE OF ACTION FOR BREACH OF CONTRACT - MOTION IS DENIED AS TO CAUSE OF ACTION 1 OF THE COMPLAINT BECAUSE DEFENDANT HAS RAISED A TRIABLE ISSUE OF MATERIAL FACT AT LEAST THROUGH EVIDENCE THAT PLAINTIFF BOOKED TALENT WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL, WHICH A TRIER OF FACT COULD CONCLUDE WAS A MATERIAL BREACH. AS TO CAUSE OF ACTION 1 OF THE CROSS-COMPLAINT, DENIED AS TO SHAWMAN FOR THE ABOVE REASON BUT GRANTED AS TO SHAW AND MAN, WHO ARE NOT PARTIES TO THE CONTRACT. AS TO CAUSE OF ACTION 2 OF THE CROSS-COMPLAINT, DENIED AS TO SHAWMAN BECAUSE CROSS-COMPLAINANT HAS RAISED A TRIABLE ISSUE OF MATERIAL FACT AS TO AT LEAST CONVERSION OF EQUIPMENT BUT GRANTED AS TO SHAW AND MAN, WHO OFFER NO EVIDENCE THEY OWNED SUCH EQUIPMENT OR THE ALLEGEDLY CONVERTED FRAUDS AS INDIVIDUALS. OPPOSING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER PURSUANT TO CCP 437 C(G). JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL A. KAREN, CSR #8189
